celebration.name_latin: Beatus Georgius Popiełuszko, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: Liturgical celebrations in honour of Blessed Jerzy Popiełuszko, priest and martyr, are conceded to the archdiocese of Warsaw (Poland); the same protocol number also covers the approval of his Latin collect, and the calendar date (19 October, optional memorial) is granted separately under Prot. 433/10/L.
excerpt: Varsaviensis, Polonia: Conceditur ut liturgicae celebrationes in honorem Beati Georgii Popiełuszko, presbyteri et martyris, peragi valeant (4 nov. 2010; Prot. 432/10/L).

summary_en: By the decree on the liturgical cult of Blessed John Paul II, pope, his celebration is inscribed on 22 October as a memorial in the proper calendar of the Diocese of Rome (the same decree does the same for all the dioceses of Poland, recorded as N2011-119-11-L-2); other particular calendars may petition the Congregation for an optional memorial. The Italian version (pp. 239-240) is dated by misprint '2 aprile 2001'.
excerpt: Disponitur, insuper, ut celebratio Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, in Calendario proprio Dioecesis Romanae seu Almae Urbis atque omnium Dioecesium Poloniae die 22 octobris gradu memoriae quotannis peragenda inscribatur.

summary_en: By the same decree on the liturgical cult of Blessed John Paul II, pope, his celebration is inscribed on 22 October as a memorial in the proper calendar of all the dioceses of Poland (the Polish national calendar is separately granted the memorial under Prot. 300/11/L, see N2011-300-11-L).
excerpt: Disponitur, insuper, ut celebratio Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, in Calendario proprio Dioecesis Romanae seu Almae Urbis atque omnium Dioecesium Poloniae die 22 octobris gradu memoriae quotannis peragenda inscribatur.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Maria a Cruce Mackillop, virgo

summary_en: St Mary of the Cross MacKillop, virgin, is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the diocese of Parramatta (Australia).
excerpt: Sancta Maria a Cruce Mackillop, virgo: Patrona caelestis diocesis Parramattensis, Australia (18 feb. 2011; Prot. 128/11/L).

summary_en: St Christopher, martyr, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the road-maintenance workers (viarum curatores) in Germany; patron of a professional category.
excerpt: Sanctus Christophorus, martyr: Patronus caelestis viarum curatorum in Germania, Germania (22 feb. 2011; Prot. 1148/09/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo s.t. Dominae Nostrae a Derelictis

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Our Lady of the Forsaken (Desamparados) is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the town of Alfara de Algimia, archdiocese of Valencia (Spain); patron of a single town.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo s.t. Dominae Nostrae a Derelictis: Patrona caelestis civitatis v.d. Alfara de Algimia; Valentini, Hispania (23 feb. 2011; Prot. 575/10/L).

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary 'a Via' (Madonna della Strada) is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the special sworn guards (custodes iurati speciales) in the city of Rome, diocese of Rome (Italy); patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo a Via: Patrona caelestis custodum iuratorum specialium in Urbe; Almae Urbis seu Romanae, Italia (26 feb. 2011; Prot. 141/11/L).

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Guadalupe is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the diocese of Tenancingo (Mexico).
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo de Guadalupe: Patrona caelestis dioecesis Tenancinganae, Mexicum (7 mar. 2011; Prot. 844/10/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the new parish community formed from the territories of the parishes of St Alexander, St Helen and St John Cantius, archdiocese of Milwaukee (U.S.A.); patron of a single parish.
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus caelestis novae communitatis paroecialis pro territorio paroeciarum Sancti Alexandri, Sanctae Helenae et Sancti Ioannis Cantii constitutae; Milvaukiensis, Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis (18 maii 2011; Prot. 451/11/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the new parish community formed from the territories of the parishes of St Cecilia and St Leo the Great, diocese of Providence (U.S.A.); patron of a single parish.
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus caelestis novae communitatis paroecialis pro territorio paroeciarum Sanctae Ceciliae et Sancti Leonis Magni constitutae; Providentiensis, Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis (18 maii 2011; Prot. 461/11/L).

summary_en: St George, martyr, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town of Lądek Zdrój (printed 'L dek Zdrój' with the 'ą' glyph missing), diocese of Świdnica (Poland); patron of a single town.
excerpt: Sanctus Georgius, martyr: Patronus caelestis urbis v.d. L dek Zdrój; Suidniciensis, Polonia (8 iun. 2011; Prot. 66/11/L).

summary_en: St George, martyr, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town of Dzierżoniów (printed 'Dzier oniów' with the 'ż' glyph missing), diocese of Świdnica (Poland); patron of a single town.
excerpt: Sanctus Georgius, martyr: Patronus caelestis civitatis v.d. Dzier oniów; Suidniciensis, Polonia (10 iun. 2011; Prot. 38/11/L).

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Coromoto is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the archdiocese of Caracas (Venezuela).
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo de Coromoto: Patrona caelestis archidioecesis Caracensis, Venetiola (15 iun. 2011; Prot. 413/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beati Ioannes Prassek et socii, presbyteri et martyres

summary_en: Liturgical celebrations in honour of Blessed Johannes Prassek and companions (the Lübeck martyrs), priests and martyrs, are conceded to the archdiocese of Hamburg (Germany); this line prints 'Passek', the text-approval line under the same protocol prints 'Prassek'; no date or rank is given.
excerpt: Hamburgensis, Germania: Liturgicae celebrationes in honorem Beatorum Ioannis Passek et sociorum, presbyterorum et martyrum, peragi valeant (15 iun. 2011; Prot. 225/11/L).
